name: Goated
description: Free movies & TV shows (up to 4K) from goated.cx. TMDB catalog (trending, popular, search, full details, seasons & episodes) plus the site's own stream resolver (proof-of-work + AES-256-GCM -> merged video+audio HLS). Fully on-device: no server, no ffmpeg, no yt-dlp. Includes Orbit & Valenox source switching.
